cards.name: Fire Arena
cards.description: Fire Arena (Lv1/2/3 — 10T/6T/3T): Fire allies gain +3/+5/+8 ATK, +2/+3/+5 On-Hit Burn & +2/+3/+5 Spell Power. Foreign elements suffer 1/2/3 end-of-turn Scorch damage.

cards.name: Light Arena
cards.description: Light Arena (Lv1/2/3 — 10T/6T/3T): Light allies cleanse + heal +3/+5/+8 DEF & heal Commander +7/+12/+16 HP each turn. Foreign elements suffer -1/-2/-3 Active Skill Power (Blinding Glare).

cards.name: Air Arena
